mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LOVE_VALUE_TEST_RESULT ( LOVE_VALUE_TEST_RESULT_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ, RESULT_TYPE, RESULT_TITLE, RESULT_EMOJI, TAGS, IDEAL_MATCH_DESC, ANSWERS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_LOVE_VALUE_TEST_RESULT.NEXTVAL, #{memberSeq}, #{resultType}, #{resultTitle}, #{resultEmoji}, #{tags}, #{idealMatchDesc}, #{answers}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT LOVE_VALUE_TEST_RESULT_SEQ AS loveValueTestResultSeq, MEMBER_SEQ AS memberSeq, RESULT_TYPE AS resultType, RESULT_TITLE AS resultTitle, RESULT_EMOJI AS resultEmoji, TAGS AS tags, IDEAL_MATCH_DESC AS idealMatchDesc, ANSWERS AS answers, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM LOVE_VALUE_TEST_RESULT WHERE MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} ORDER BY LOVE_VALUE_TEST_RESULT_SEQ DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
